record.question: Consider the following statements: (i) Pasal\ha Khuangchera is not only known for his bravery but also his strength and righteousness that won over the hearts of the people. (ii) He was killed while trying to resist the advancing British troops in 1890, which marked the British conquest of the Lushai Hills. (iii) He is known as the first Mizo freedom fighter to have sacrificed his life, after Lalnu Ropuiliani, fighting British imperialism. (iv) The region (New Mizoram) was formally incorporated into the British Empire in 1895. Which of the following is/are correct?
